tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// bsngags 'os la bsngags pa'i rab byed bzhugs// ༄༅// bsngags par 'os pa'i rab tu byed pa zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal kun gyi ni 'byung gnas te// srid pa gsum gyi skyabs gcig po// che ba'i che bas gus btud pa// sangs rgyas dpal gyi phul la 'dud// rgyal po khyod kyis sngon spyad pa'i// dge tshogs rgya mtsho las grub pa'i// dpal 'di phyogs mthar gtugs pa yi// 'gro la slar yang brtan gyur cig /khyod kyis rgyal srid rgyu dang ni// dka' tshegs chen pos ma bzhes kyang*// nyid kyi dpal dang bden pa'i mthus// ci bder dbang bgyis ngo mtshar lags// khyod kyi mched sogs rgyal rgyud gzhan// gzhan gyis bslus nas log zhugs rnams// phyogs bslad gyur bzhin nyer lhags te// khyod zhabs btud pa ya mtshan lags// snga rabs rgyal po mang zhig gis// rang gi skur bcas sde chen gyi// tshogs kyis gdul bar ma spyod pa'i// rgyal por bcas pa'i rgyal srid gzhan// khyod sku bskyod par ma mdzad cing*// shin tu rtsol ba'ang mi mnga' bzhin// rang dbang nyid du dbang mdzad de// de yi 'byor pas kun 'byor du// mdzad nas de dag bde la slar// bkod 'di sngon chad sa steng 'dir// byung ba sus kyang ma 'tshal ba'i// snyan pas sa gsum rab khyab pas// rang srid snyems pa'i dpal 'phel zhing*// phyogs gzhan dri bzhin yid g.yo bar// gyur 'di khyod nyid gcig pu'i dpal// do zlas rnam par dben pa lags// dpal 'byor 'di 'dra mthong ba'i mig /kun nas za zir gyur pa ni// sna tshogs sgyu ma'i cho 'phrul gyis// rnam par bslad pa'i mig 'drar mchis// 'di 'dra thos pa'i nyan shes kyis// yid dbang rnam par bskyod pa ni// skom pas gdung ba rnams kyi yid// klung chen sgra yis bskul 'drar mchis// khyod kyi dpal gyis rgyal srid dag /so sor brtan pa'ang 'dres gyur pa// 'khor los sgyur ba'i dpal rgyas kyis// gling bzhi gcig tu 'dres 'drar mchis// 'di 'dra gnas ris gong ma yi// lha rnams dag gis mthong gyur bas// snyigs ma'i dus la de dag yid// kun nas som nyir gyur lags grang*// 'di 'dra'i dpal 'bras smin gyur pas// khyod kyi bde 'gro brnyes bgyi ba'i// phun sum tshogs pas phun tshogs slad// smon par bgyi gzhan ma mchis so// de slad skye dgu thams cad kyis// dpal 'byor 'di 'dras 'byor gyur pa'i// sa bdag sngon chad ma byung zhing*// 'di yis nyid sras bzhin bskyangs pa'i// 'bangs kyang sngon chad ma byung zhes// phan tshun dga' bas ga zha'i sgra// nye bar sgrogs pa'i sil snyan sgras// khyed kyi thugs kyang dgyes 'gyur zhing*// skye dgu'ang dga' bar mdzad du gsol// khrims kyi rmos kyis srid 'bangs kyi// zhing sa dul bar bgyis pa las// chos kyi sa bon btab bgyis te// zang zing chu lud nyer bran pas// bde 'gro'i 'byor pa'i myu gu dang*// rnam grol lo tog smin pa la// bdag gzhan dgyes dgur spyod par mdzod// gang gi bsod nams gser gyi gzhir// dpal 'byor chu gter nyer 'khyil ba// bdag gzhan kun gyi dus kun du// lhug par gang spyod de rmad do// gtsug lag du ma'i don la thugs// kun nas gsal bar gyur khyod kyis// ma dpyad pa yi dngos po dang*// mi mkhyen pa yi chos ma mchis// de slad khyod kyis mkhyen pa yi// slad du tshig 'di ma smos kyang*// snyan grags thos pas bdag gi yid// spro ba'i slad du smos pa lags// pad rgyas dri bsung bser bu yis// bskyod pas ring gnas nyam chung gis// bung bas tshor tshe stobs med kyang*// dar dir sgra snyan sgrogs pa bzhin// de ltar bsngags bgyir 'os khyod la// bdag gis bsngags pas nyer bskul nas// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad kyis// bsngags shing shis pa gsung gyur cig

/khyod sku lhun po lta bur brtan// dpal 'byor rgya mtsho che ltar 'khyil// 'dod dgu'i rin chen rnam mang gis// skye dgu rtag tu tshim byed shog /hor gyi rgyal rabs lnga pa rgyal po chen po go pe la zhes bya ba'i bsod nams kyi dpal gyis/ rgyal khams thams cad gcig tu bzlum zhing*/ khyad par du yun ring po nas/ rgyal rabs bar ma chad par rgyal srid brtan par gnas pa/ man tse zhes bya ba'i rgyal khams rab tu yangs pa tha gru dang bcas pa ngo bltas te/ mi'i dbang po'i zhabs kyi padmo la gtugs nas/ dpal 'byor gyi gzis rgya mtsho'i mthas gtugs pa'i sa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad khyab par mdzad pa la bsngags pa'i rab tu byed pa zhes bya ba 'di dge slong 'phags pas shing mo phag gi lo ston zla 'bring po'i tshes nyi shu gnyis kyi nyin par skar ma rgyal la bab pa'i tshe smar khams kyi sa'i cha tsom mdo gnas gsar zhes bya bar sbyar ba'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
